title: Q6
description:
Read: Psa 2:1-9

The decree is spoken to the anointed king on Zion while the nations rage, and it ends with a rod of iron. You already hold that this "today" is the resurrection.

a) The verse cites only the sonship line. What in the rest of the psalm is still attached to that decree?

b) In the psalm itself, what day is "today" the day of?
